patch_resolves_note: The fixed OpenSC loop keeps the ECC OID copy path but adds the missing `j < SC_MAX_OBJECT_ID_OCTETS` guard, so the protected `oid.value[j] = blob->data[j+1]` write still executes and the last fixed iteration stays at `j = 15` instead of reaching `j = 16`.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: At each ECC OID copy-loop iteration that reaches `oid.value[j] = blob->data[j+1];`, the loop index `j` must satisfy `j < SC_MAX_OBJECT_ID_OCTETS`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original only checks `j < (blob->len - 1)`, so the copy loop reaches the assignment with `j == 16`. The fixed original adds the missing `j < SC_MAX_OBJECT_ID_OCTETS` conjunct to the same loop header, and the protected write still executes with the last in-bounds index `j == 15`.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: Vulnerable original: oid_copy_guard.write_index=16 with oid_copy_guard.oid_capacity=16 while oid_copy_write executes. Fixed original: the same protected write executes with oid_copy_guard.write_index=15 and oid_copy_guard.oid_capacity=16.

nodes.state: At the sink assignment, `j >= SC_MAX_OBJECT_ID_OCTETS`, so the write targets an index at or past the 16-element `oid.value` array.

edges.relation: The same loop index `j` evaluated at the root-cause guard is the index immediately used by `oid.value[j] = blob->data[j+1]` at the sink.
edges.evidence: Vulnerable original: oid_copy_guard.write_index == oid_copy_write.write_index == 16. Fixed original: the last executed in-bounds copy uses 15 at both events.
